sentences: IEEE-754 floating-point class tests against the 10-bit class mask (`0: sNaN, 1: qNaN, 2: -inf, 3: -normal, 4: -denormal, 5: -0, 6: +0, 7: +denormal, 8: +normal, 9: +inf`), writing VCC/SGPR or narrowing EXEC (`v_cmpx`).

Computed bit-exactly on integer words (so `sNaN` is never quieted by float ops and `v_cmp(x)_class_f64` does not require `OpCapability Float64`): `f16` reads the selected half (`op_sel[0]`, inline f16 constants via `src_h`) and applies `abs`/`neg` on bits `[15:0]`; `f64` reads the `(lo, hi)` pair (32-bit literals placed in the upper word with `lo = 0` per RDNA2 ISA) and applies `abs`/`neg` on `hi`.
Output modifiers (`clamp`, `mul:*`, `div:*`) and unsupported `op_sel` bits raise `Unsupported`.

Checked bit-for-bit across all 10 classes on the CPU (`spirv_mini_interp`) and with `spirv-val` by `tests/semantic/test_alu_cmp_class_f16_f64.py`; **not GPU-verified** and not run on the shader corpus.
